verses.english: What needs to be done with firm persistence, what needs to be done by one who hopes for awakening, that I will do. I will not fail. See: persistence & striving! You show me the path: the straight, the plunge into deathlessness. I, through sagacity, will reach it, know it, as the stream of the Ganges, the sea.
